author: Whalien5212
quote: Playing it again felt like a trip back to my childhood. I used to play Zelda every afternoon, trying to get through its levels even though I was too young to really understand them. Reliving that experience was wonderful. Everything about the game is perfect: the quality, the graphics, the gameplay. It’s clear that a lot of love went into its creation, which makes it truly special. On top of the improvements they made, hearing the soundtrack again was just perfect. If it was art before, listening to each track now feels like a total blessing. A fantastic game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Whalien5212
quote: A 13-year wait, only to be given a game that is anything but a Grand Theft Auto title. The story is weak, and the missions are boring often repetitive, too. The characters lack personality. It strays far from what this series is truly about; you can’t pull off heists, and you can’t cause chaos. They’ve completely ruined those aspects by leaning too hard into realism. It’s not necessarily a "bad" game. Take GTA IV, for instance; it was somewhat realistic, yet it still managed to retain that core GTA essence but this one just doesn’t. Honestly, it’s disappointing to see this labeled "Game of the Year" when it’s really nothing special. It’s incredible that a game like Zelda a series whose story we’re already familiar with is far more entertaining. I’d even go so far as to say that Gears of War and Halo (also franchises with well-known stories) are more engaging than this. Truly disappointing.
